research_outcome: BOUNDED_SUPPORTED — movement/trade of enslaved people through bounded parts of the medieval trans-Saharan caravan network is supported across the 1300 horizon, with direct mid-fourteenth-century caravan evidence; exact-1300 volume and all-route participation remain unresolved
bounded_proposition: Specialist scholarship identifies a trans-Saharan slave trade spanning approximately 750–1500; direct 1353 evidence records a northbound caravan carrying 600 female slaves from the central Sudan toward Morocco, supporting genuine network participation rather than slavery only at connected nodes.
required_abstention: Do not infer an exact 1300 caravan count, annual volume, equal participation by every route, territorial slavery at every node, captive=traded slave automatically, Mansa Musa retinue counts as decisive trade evidence, later trade scale at 1300, or a fixed route/practice polygon.
evidence_locus: Medieval system-level synthesis; Takedda–Tuat–Sijilmasa northbound caravan; Taghaza node; wider Sudanic-Saharan-Maghrib entrepôt system.
inference_extent: Bounded medieval/fourteenth-century network participation with one direct route event; not uniform across the multi-route network and not a territorial-practice claim.
law_practice_note: The evidence establishes movement/trade and slave labour in bounded network contexts; no single network-wide law/status regime is inferred.
network_territorial_note: Network participation remains distinct from territorial slavery in Mali, Saharan nodes or Maghrib destinations; one corridor cannot define the whole network.
historical_terms: slave; female slaves; caravan; Massufa; Taghaza; Takedda; Tuat; Sijilmasa
category_mapping_note: Direct caravan movement of enslaved women is preserved as network evidence; Taghaza slave labour is node context; court/retainer or captive evidence is not converted into commercial movement without a bridge.
language_access_limitations: Arabic primary material accessed through established translations/specialist syntheses; no exhaustive Arabic manuscript collation. Exact terminology in each medieval witness remains edition-dependent.
geometry_claim_role: Network navigation/context only; no evidence-derived slavery polygon.
geometry_unresolved_note: Routes shifted over time and direct evidence is corridor-specific; no Sahara-wide practice geometry authorized.
